Features

Built for the work
behind your business.

A connected set of tools for sales, suppliers, stock, money and reporting. Feature availability depends on your plan and the released application.

Basic · Business · Complete

Serve customers. Get paid.

Keep customer details together. Prepare quotes and invoices, record payments and organise everyday business costs (expenses).

Basic includes customer balances, expense receipt capture and simple reports. Bizzy can help with everyday business questions.

Business · Complete

Know where your money stands.

See money customers still owe you (accounts receivable), money you owe suppliers (accounts payable), customer statements, credit notes and customer refunds.

Record supplier invoices and payments, capture supported supplier invoices for review, track assets and depreciation, match bank transactions to your records and explore detailed accounting and VAT reports.

Complete

Follow your products and stock.

Create purchase orders, record stock arriving from suppliers, and see available, reserved or low stock.

Review stock quantities and value, customer product returns and inventory reports. Bizzy can help answer questions about your stock.

This guide follows the existing public plan comparison. The application’s entitlement rules determine access; confirm availability for your closed-beta workspace. Document assistance and specific formats depend on what is enabled.

Requisitions, with a second pair of eyes

Less retyping.
More careful review.

O-IBS can assist with extracting information from uploaded requisitions and matching recognised products. Uncertain descriptions, quantities and matches need human review before you proceed.

A considered workflow.

  • Upload a requisition.
  • Review extracted information.
  • Check recognised product matches.
  • Resolve uncertain details before taking action.
